aiResearchSummary.text: Synthetic Minds is focused on developing systems for securing smart contracts through program synthesis. Their research includes creating frameworks for building automations from desktop recordings, which can be applied to smart contract environments. This involves using program synthesis to automate processes by analyzing changes in world states, enhancing the security and efficiency of smart contracts.
